description: This file is the main activity for an Android application demonstrating input content commit handling. It manages input views, handles content MIME types, and facilitates content sharing via InputConnection.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity that demonstrates handling of input content through several edit text fields with different MIME type configurations. It processes content commits, manages permissions, and displays content details.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up layout, creates multiple input fields with different MIME types, and restores saved state.

methods.name: onCommitContent
methods.description: Handles commit of content from IME, verifies MIME types support, and invokes internal processing.

methods.name: onCommitContentInternal
methods.description: Processes committed input content, requests permissions if needed, updates UI, and loads content into WebView.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves current input content info and flags into bundle for activity state restoration.

methods.name: createEditTextWithContentMimeTypes
methods.description: Creates an EditText configured to specify supported content MIME types for testing input content handling.

methods.name: flagsToString
methods.description: Converts flag integers into human-readable string representations.
